verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's own marketing says access can be scoped with roles down to the table and column level, which covers part of the story. That rests on a single thin claim, and nothing in the pack mentions row-level policies or masking. Missing for 10: row-level access policies, column masking policies, in-depth first-party docs on role/grant configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, access control reaches tables, columns, and rows — roles plus masking policies — so one warehouse can serve many teams safely

citations.quote: Scope access with roles down to the table and column
